raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was delivered twice: a 02:00 load and a 05:00 re-delivery of the same transactions, so batch 13 has 654 rows against a normal ~340. The silver step does not deduplicate, so each re-delivered txn_id appears twice among POSTED rows, which doubles the 2026-01-17 volume and inflates the gold aggregates. Keeping one row per txn_id, using the earliest delivery, restores the expected volume (about 305 unique rows for 01-17 against a median of 329), but this assumes the duplicate copies are identical and not corrected values.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.55, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC, batch_id ASC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
